pageFacts.text: 1) Learn the Mantra from NPCs in the virtue's city. 2) Meditate at the shrine using the mantra for three cycles. 3) Visit the Codex on the Isle of the Avatar to receive guidance. 4) Return & Complete by meditating again to gain stats.
These "passwords" are essential for progressing through the game. Mantras are used at the Shrines of Virtue, while Words of Power unlock the dungeons.

source.locator: Mantras & Words of Power panel, introduction

pageFacts.text: Completing all eight shrine quests grants the Word of Power for Doom: VERAMOCOR.
Above, the three Shadowlords bend cities toward Falsehood, Hatred, and Cowardice while Blackthorn's regime punishes virtue without choice.

gentleHints.opening-party: Balance healing, utility magic, and ranged fighting before a long expedition. A planned party is not proof of recruitment.
gentleHints.opening-grapple: Ask about climbing equipment when speaking to people at the Abbey.
gentleHints.opening-hms-cape: Explore the shipwright’s premises carefully; useful plans may not be on open display.
gentleHints.opening-raid-kit: Plan for locked doors, recovery, and retreat before committing to the castle.
gentleHints.opening-castle-raid: Watch the guards and search the private rooms carefully. Music can reward patient investigation.
gentleHints.shadow-faulinei: Match the opposing principle with the shard you recover. The final confrontation depends on more than ordinary attacks.
gentleHints.shadow-astaroth: There is more than one route toward this shard. Keep the destination and its matching sacred flame distinct.
gentleHints.shadow-nosfentor: Prepare for a difficult descent, then bring what you recover back to the appropriate sacred flame.
gentleHints.regalia-sceptre: Bring tools for difficult terrain and sealed doors. Listen carefully when challenged.
gentleHints.regalia-crown: Plan your escape before entering the guarded fortress.
gentleHints.regalia-amulet: The expedition left evidence below Britannia. Prepare a way out before descending.
gentleHints.doom-rescue: Review the royal artifacts, supplies, and pilgrimage before committing to the final descent.
gentleHints.side-magic-carpet: Search the castle’s private upper rooms and prepare for a magical lock.
gentleHints.side-grapple: Ask about climbing equipment at the Abbey.
gentleHints.side-jaana: A hidden route in town can lead to a captive companion.
gentleHints.side-resistance-party: Think about the roles your party still needs; recruitment is separate from planning.
gentleHints.side-skull-keys: Investigate Minoc at night. The guide does not establish one consistent cache refresh schedule.
gentleHints.side-glass-swords: Search the mountains carefully and reserve powerful single-use weapons for dangerous encounters.
gentleHints.side-hms-cape: A shipwright’s plans can improve an existing vessel.
gentleHints.side-magic-axe: Explore the town’s less obvious paths before buying expensive equipment.
gentleHints.side-reagents: Some rare reagents can be gathered in the wild. Watch the time as well as the place.
gentleHints.side-navigation: Seek sailors and coastal residents who may help you navigate.
gentleHints.side-mystic-arms: A prepared Underworld expedition can include a search for optional equipment.

research.title: Gaining levels
research.text: Ultima V grants earned levels only while the party rests: after reaching the experience needed, hole up and camp for the maximum number of hours, and the spirit of Lord British may appear to grant the level. It takes some luck. Each new level adds 30 hit points, and the attribute increases are chosen fairly randomly.

research.title: An Zu (Awaken)
aliases: someone in my party is asleep
research.text: AN ZU (first circle; Garlic and Ginseng) awakens a sleeping companion. It works only on members of the caster’s own party and wakes one person per casting.

research.title: Lord British
research.text: Lord British is the king of Britannia. The Book of Lore describes him sharing government with a Great Council representing the eight major towns.
